g.text: Normalized RMS residual (%) · lower is better

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: All 24 curves: model residuals and the actual Google Benchmark choice
Six zero-intercept models fitted separately to each realization; no pooling across graphs, samplers, families or algorithms.
Red outline: reported oAuto CPU choice (left); independently selected upper-window custom fit (right).
Google uses 33 two-call library CPU means and reuses that model for its manual coefficient. Upper-six fits use 18 means and are not built-in results.
Only CPU RMS is exported by Google; manual RMS is reconstructed. Four-clock/all-model fits remain in CSV. Fit labels do not prove asymptotic complexity.
